product.title: Nera, o pisicuta fara stapan
product.description: Amy și-a dorit dintotdeauna o pisicuță, dar mamași tatăl ei nu se lasă deloc convinși că e destul de maresă aibă grijă de un animal. Așa că fetița nu mai poate debucurie când zărește un ghemotoc cu blana neagră îngrădina casei. E foarte mic și nu are zgardă,iar Amy e sigură că nu are nici stăpân. Dar oareva vrea pisicuța să rămână la ea?

The story centers around Amy, a girl with a huge love for cats. Although she dreams of having her own feline companion, both her mother and father are hesitant about the commitment of pet ownership.

One day, while exploring their yard, Amy discovers something unexpected: a tiny black kitten named Nera. The little stray is small and seemingly without an owner. As Amy observes the cute kitten, a poignant question hangs in the air: Does this sweet creature belong to someone else? Or is it meant to find its forever home with her?

This engaging narrative beautifully captures the excitement of discovery and the responsibility that comes with caring for a vulnerable life. It's a gentle read perfect for sparking conversations about empathy and community care.
